note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Mukherjee et al. (Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India); the original is in English; it contains the alate and soldier castes under 'Diagnostic Character'; the main text has no measurements (they are in tables 14 and 15 of the original and were not included); the OCR is basically clear.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate head and thorax grass yellow to pale brown, pronotum trapezoidal, narrower than the head width including the eyes, wings weakly pilose; soldier head rectangular, distinctly longer than wide, posterior margin rounded, mandibles long and sword-shaped, antennae 14—16-segmented (mostly 15). The main text of the original gives no measurements; measurements are in tables 14 and 15 of the original.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head and thorax grass yellow to pale brown; antennae, labium and abdominal tergites paler. Head and pronotum sparsely pilose, abdomen moderately pilose. Head subquadrate, sides weakly rounded, posterior margin more strongly rounded. Fontanelle small, dot-like, round. Ocelli very small, dot-like, their distance from the compound eyes twice their long diameter. Antennae 16—18-segmented, segments 3 and 4 nearly equal in length. Postclypeus weakly arched, with a distinct median longitudinal line. Labrum and mandibles of the Heterotermes type. Pronotum trapezoidal, narrower than the head width including the eyes, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, only weakly concave. Wings weakly pilose, venation of the Heterotermes type.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow to brownish yellow. Head and pronotum with a few long hairs and some short hairs, abdomen more densely pilose. Head rectangular, distinctly longer than wide; sides nearly parallel, narrowed posteriorly, posterior margin rounded. Fontanelle not evident, with a brown tube; fontanelle gland area pale yellow. Antennae 14—16-segmented (generally 15), segment 3 variable, shorter or longer than segment 2, equal to or longer than segment 4. Labrum lanceolate, with a transparent spine-like tip at the apex. Mandibles long, sword-shaped, outer margin rather straight, apex weakly incurved. Postmentum rod-shaped, rather long, widest in the rod part. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal, anterior margin weakly concave in the middle; posterior margin also weakly to deeply concave, wider than long.
